ask_for_confirmation_on_delete.markdownDescription: Ask for confirmation before sending files/folders to the trash. Set to `false` to send them to the trash straight away.

complete_with_files_too.markdownDescription: Auto-complete file names in addition to folder names.

pick_first.markdownDescription: Order of completions when `complete_with_files_too` is enabled.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Files and folders mixed, in alphabetical order.

case_sensitive.markdownDescription: Whether path auto-completion is case sensitive.

index_folder_separator.markdownDescription: Separator between a project folder index and the path, e.g. `1>src/file.py` creates relative to the second project folder. Should be a character that can't appear in a file name.

default_index.markdownDescription: Index of the project folder that paths are relative to when no index is given in the input.

log_in_status_bar.markdownDescription: How to show the resolved path in the status bar while typing.

terminals.markdownDescription: Terminals for *Open Terminal Here*. If only one is available on the current platform it is opened directly, otherwise a quick panel lists them. `$cwd` in `cmd` is replaced by the working directory.

name.markdownDescription: Name shown in the quick panel.

cmd.markdownDescription: Command and arguments. `$cwd` is replaced by the working directory.

platform.markdownDescription: Space-separated platforms the terminal is available on (`windows`, `osx`, `linux`). Omit to make it available everywhere.

menu_without_distraction.markdownDescription: Hide commands that are disabled instead of showing them greyed out.

explicitly_refresh_sidebar.markdownDescription: Explicitly refresh the side bar after any action that may affect it (Sublime Text normally does this by itself).

reveal_in_sidebar.markdownDescription: Reveal the file in the side bar after creating, renaming, duplicating, etc.

save_after_creating.markdownDescription: Save a file right after creating it (useful because a snippet may be inserted).

aliases.markdownDescription: Aliases usable as `$name` in path inputs. Values can use Sublime Text variables (`$file_path`, `$folder`, `$packages`, ... including defaults like `${file_path:~}`) and other aliases. Setting this replaces the default aliases entirely.

open_help_on_alias_infinite_loop.markdownDescription: Open the help page when aliases reference each other in an infinite loop.

show_copy_command.markdownDescription: Show the *Copy* commands (name/path). Note: hiding them leaves an empty *Copy* submenu in the side bar.

create_keybinding_enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the default `alt+n` key binding for *New...*.
